(SSTATUS MACRO /% '(LAMBDA () (TYI)    ()  ) SPLICING)
(SSTATUS MACRO /@ '(LAMBDA () (TYI) '(ABCD)) SPLICING)

(TYIPEEK T)     %A       a
=Returns=> 141

(TYIPEEK T)     @A       a
=Returns=> 141

; This seems un-intuitive to me. -- Macros that do (TYIPEEK T) to find 
; the start of the next token are gonna lose big.

%A 'A
=Returns=> A
'@A
=Returns=> ABCD
